'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]

*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East]]
***The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] shoots down an Iranian [[Shahed drones|Shahed 139]] drone on approach to the [[aircraft carrier]] [[USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)|USS ''Abraham Lincoln'']] with an [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 fighter jet]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-35-killed-bandits-raid-kwara-state-community-lawmaker-says-2026-02-04/ (Reuters)]
